description: This file defines the class `DefaultPersistenceOperationsConfig`, which implements the `PersistenceOperationsConfig` interface. It provides configuration management related to persistence operations, specifically handling a delay duration after persistence actor shutdown. It includes method to instantiate its configuration from a `Config` object and overrides standard methods (`equals`, `hashCode`, `toString`).

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceOperationsConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for persistence operations, encapsulating delay duration after actor shutdown.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of `DefaultPersistenceOperationsConfig` from a `Config` object, using a predefined config path.

methods.name: getDelayAfterPersistenceActorShutdown
methods.description: Returns the configured duration to wait after persistence actor shutdown.
